history_rule: This is a prospective tree, not a merge commit. Actual publication must retain H and its source ancestors in reachable history, and preserve B through the permitted current-main writer process. The two original changed blobs remain bound to H and to the original snapshot; tree construction does not itself deliver history.
scope_limits: No fresh Lean, generator, graph enumeration, Git invocation, Git object creation, source/ref mutation, Ready transition, or merge.
All B descendants are covered by exact tree-entry identity and reconstructed compact frontier; opaque unchanged subtrees were not expanded or rebuilt.
Proof evidence is reused only for the 104 byte-identical registry modules and recorded dependency graph. This is not a whole-main proof rebuild.
Candidate assumes exact pinned B, H, and sealed patch bytes. Any later evidence packaging, source, registry, or base change requires an additive tree-binding refresh.
Current owner adoption, eligible readiness, integration ownership, and actual platform requirements remain separate root-campaign gates.
